text:
zoe_sales: Kicking off BankX POC thread — they want enterprise SSO/SCIM + multi-tenant domain delegation. Need clarity on domain claim flow, group->role mapping, SCIM auth options, and a committed Dedicated estimate.

mina_se: Quick ask for BankX: list of domains to verify, whether they need org-wide delegation (one claim across subdomains), and if they require per-route RBAC or org-level roles.

client_it_bankx: We control bankx.com, bankx-eu.com, and partner.bankx.com. Ideally one org-level claim that covers partner.* and subdomains, but if DNS validation requires one TXT per host we can handle it. We want groups->roles mapping and tenant isolation on routing.

carlos_ts: Notes for implementation: org-level delegation is possible but requires proof of ownership for each delegated domain owner or a parent delegation record. Operationally that can add 2-5 business days per external domain. For SCIM: POC = bearer token (90d rotation), prod we recommend mTLS. For RBAC we support group->role table and claim-based rules; group mapping is simplest for POC.

mina_se: SCIM test payload we'll use in the POC config: ```json
{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:ListResponse"],"Resources":[{"id":"u-204","userName":"k.perez@bankx.com","externalId":"bx|204","emails":[{"value":"k.perez@bankx.com"}],"groups":["trading","ops"]}]}
```
Mapping: trading->trade-analyst, ops->ops-operator. Set initial SCIM rate-limit 60 req/min for their sync.

ellie_security: Security checklist: 1) POC bearer token ok, but flag for prod mTLS; 2) Audit logs default 90d, enterprise option 365d (billing note); 3) SAML cert rotation supported; add to SOW; 4) Domain delegation increases attack surface — we require DNS TXT on every delegated root and service owner signoff.

sasha_legal: Legal needs a short SOW snippet covering metadata exchange, cert rotation, provisioning termination, domain verification, and EU data residency if requested. Can we get exact list of domains and the team contacts for signoff?

zoe_sales: Pricing ask: committed Dedicated for 140 req/s sustained, ~1.4M tokens/day. Need reserved monthly + overage, enterprise support, extended logs. Carlos, can you prepare a customer-facing estimate that calls out the domain-delegation onboarding delta and RBAC per-route premium?

carlos_ts: Will prepare estimate with line items: reserved GPU pool monthly, per-1k token overage, 24/7 support add-on, 90->365d log upgrade, and a ‘domain-delegation’ onboarding fee for each externally-owned domain. Note caveat: tight latency SLOs or per-route RBAC may require higher commit.

client_it_bankx: We can provide metadata and initial group list by EOD. We need SOW + estimate within 24h to proceed with finance. EU residency required for production.

ellie_security: I'll draft the security QA and the minimal SSO/SCIM SOW clause. Reminder: if BankX opts into per-route logging or tenant-specific KMS keys, implementation time + cost increase.

pt_deploybot: Deploy scheduled: feature/bankx-identity-poc -> staging at 2024-11-02T12:00Z :rocket:

zoe_sales: Plan: Mina & Carlos to start config when metadata + SCIM token arrive, Ellie & Sasha to complete security & SOW pieces, Carlos to send estimate. Sync in 24h. :thumbsup:
